name: Pamekasan

queries.query: Pamekasan official cadastral parcel map GIS Indonesia ATR BPN
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official ATR/BPN Pamekasan land-office site and the national BHUMI/ATLAS spatial portal. BHUMI documentation describes open spatial viewing and registered-land parcels, but no safe anonymous parcel feature response was verified.

queries.query: Pamekasan peta bidang tanah kadaster resmi GIS ATR BPN
queries.result: Pencarian sumber resmi menemukan Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Pamekasan, katalog Satu Data Kabupaten Pamekasan yang mencantumkan indikator pertanahan/pemetaan, dan portal BHUMI ATR/BPN. Tidak ditemukan endpoint publik anonim yang mengembalikan ID bidang tanah dan geometri lengkap yang aman.

sourceAssessment.officialCityService: The official Kabupaten Pamekasan ATR/BPN land-office site was reachable. The official BHUMI/ATLAS portal is the current national spatial viewer and its public JavaScript configuration names a registered-land layer (Bidang Tanah) served through the BHUMI GIS route.
sourceAssessment.localRegistryProcedure: The Pamekasan ATR/BPN office site evidences the local land-registration custodian. Pamekasan Satu Data also lists land administration, land mapping and land-value indicators, but these catalog entries are not a parcel geometry API.
sourceAssessment.openGeometrySource: No qualifying open geometry source was retained. BHUMI's current client routes Geoserver parcel retrieval through /expapi/getPersil with a token/login flow; no login or embedded credentials were used. Direct anonymous WMS/WFS capability guesses at the public BHUMI host returned HTTP 404.
sourceAssessment.nativeIdentity: Not verified from a successful feature response; no identity was retained.

fieldMapping.safe_candidate_identity: native parcel ID only if returned by a future safe feature response
fieldMapping.excluded: owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, title or personal fields

sourceAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key constructed; no parcel feature was retained.
sourceAssessment.crs: Not verified from a parcel feature response. The WUP point was used only as the fixed research reference and was not shifted.
sourceAssessment.sampleScope: No polygon retained. A zero/unknown exact-point hit or unavailable parcel response is not evidence of citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Pamekasan local land-office custody plus the national ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS spatial viewer and Pamekasan Satu Data catalog.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official custody and viewer/catalog pages were reachable; parcel schema, CRS, native identity, anonymous query response and citywide completeness were not verified.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Pamekasan ATR/BPN land-office page reachable; local registry custodian evidenced, but no parcel API exposed.
Local government data catalog reachable; land-mapping and land-administration indicators listed, but no safe parcel feature response.

blocker: Local registry custody and a current national viewer were evidenced, but no independent anonymous ID-plus-complete-geometry response was verified. Runtime integration remains held.
remainingUncertainty: The viewer's authenticated/token-mediated parcel request shape, exact parcel schema and CRS, and citywide coverage remain unverified. No owner, address, title, tax, account or personal fields were requested or retained.
nextStep: A serial reviewer may independently qualify an approved public route if the current BHUMI service publishes one; retain only a stable native parcel ID and geometry.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON sample retained. Any future sample must use exactly one stable native source identity as properties.id and geometry only.
